title: Email proof database operations
responsibility: Provide email proof, send-rate and verified-address storage methods.

inputs.name: d1EmailStores.db
inputs.description: D1-compatible database handle; queries run only when the returned store methods are called.

inputs.name: d1EmailStores.records
inputs.description: Validator used to turn stored database rows into typed records.

outputs.name: EMAIL_PURGES
outputs.description: SQL statements to remove expired proofs and verified addresses and send-ledger rows at least two days old; callers supply the current time and execute them.

outputs.name: d1EmailStores
outputs.description: Proof store supports creation, lookup, live-code replacement, bounded attempts, single claimed-proof completion and removal. Ledger supports atomic interval/day-cap checks and verified-address lookup/replacement.
